summary: Reads channel/key data from an Animation COMP and outputs sampled CHOP channels for animation playback, lookup, or export workflows.
key_concepts: Reads channel and key data stored inside an Animation COMP and outputs sampled CHOP channels.
The Animation COMP and Animation Editor are the authoring surface for creating, editing, and deleting keyframes.
Adding an input changes the Keyframe CHOP into lookup-index playback, and a time-sliced input produces time-sliced output.
Sample Rate controls CHOP samples per second independently of the TouchDesigner timeline frame rate.
Extend Left, Extend Right, and Default Value determine behavior outside the keyed range.
Specific Info CHOP channels expose start and end positions as index, frame, second, and fraction values.
common_gotchas: Requires a populated Animation COMP; the CHOP only exposes existing keyframed channel data.
Adding an input turns the input into a lookup index, so planners should not wire arbitrary modulation without intending lookup playback.
When the input is time-sliced, the Keyframe CHOP outputs a proper time slice rather than a static range.
Extend conditions determine values outside the keyed range and can produce cycles, mirrored cycles, slope continuation, or defaults.
Use the Animation Editor to create/edit/delete the underlying keyframed channels; this CHOP is not the editing UI.
